Skill.Name: warranty-period-checker
Skill.Summary: 依購買日期與報修日期判定家電是否仍在一年保固內，並計算保固最後一天及過保天數。當使用者提供一筆或多筆家電購買與報修日期、需要檢查保固狀態時使用。

Criteria.Text: 判定為已過保，且過保 1 天（保固最後一天為 2026-08-19，報修日 2026-08-20 晚 1 天）

request.FinalOutput:
不在一年保固內。依提供的日期，保固最後一天是 2026-08-19；2026-08-20 報修時已過保 1 天。

第 1 筆：保固最後一天 2026-08-19；已過保 1 天

5	import argparse

11	
12	FIELD_TYPES = ("date", "number", "hours", "text")
13	MONTHS = 12
14	CHINESE_DIGITS = {
15	    "零": 0,
16	    "〇": 0,
17	    "一": 1,
18	    "二": 2,
19	    "兩": 2,
20	    "两": 2,
21	    "三": 3,
22	    "四": 4,
23	    "五": 5,
24	    "六": 6,
25	    "七": 7,
26	    "八": 8,
27	    "九": 9,
28	}
29	CHINESE_UNITS = {"十": 10, "百": 100, "千": 1000}
30	CHINESE_SECTIONS = {"萬": 10_000, "万": 10_000, "億": 100_000_000, "亿": 100_000_000}
31	ARABIC_WITH_SECTION = re.compile(r"^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*([萬万億亿千百])$")
32	FRACTION = re.compile(r"^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*/\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$")
33	PLAIN_NUMBER = re.compile(r"^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$")
34	HOURS_AND_MINUTES = re.compile(
35	    r"^(?:(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:小時|小时|鐘頭|h|hr|hrs|hours?))?\s*"
36	    r"(?:(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:分鐘|分钟|分|m|min|mins|minutes?))?$",
37	    re.IGNORECASE,
38	)
39	FULL_DATE = re.compile(r"^(\d{4})\s*[-/.年]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[-/.月]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*日?$")
40	MONTH_DAY = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2})\s*[/月]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*日?$")
41	MONTH_EDGE = re.compile(r"^(?:(\d{4})\s*年\s*)?(\d{1,2})\s*月\s*(底|初)$")
42	RELATIVE_DAYS = {
43	    "大前天": -3,
44	    "前天": -2,
45	    "昨天": -1,
46	    "今天": 0,
47	    "明天": 1,
48	    "後天": 2,
49	    "后天": 2,
50	    "大後天": 3,
51	    "大后天": 3,
52	}
53	DAYS_FROM_NOW = re.compile(r"^(\d+)\s*天(後|后|前)$")
54	
55	
56	class UnusableValueError(ValueError):
57	    """A value that cannot be right; its message names why."""
58	
59	
60	def chinese_number(text: str) -> float:
61	    total, section, digit = 0, 0, None
62	    for ch in text:
63	        if ch in CHINESE_DIGITS:
64	            digit = CHINESE_DIGITS[ch]
65	        elif ch in CHINESE_UNITS:
66	            section += (1 if digit is None else digit) * CHINESE_UNITS[ch]
67	            digit = None
68	        elif ch in CHINESE_SECTIONS:
69	            total += (section + (digit or 0)) * CHINESE_SECTIONS[ch]
70	            section, digit = 0, None
71	        else:
72	            raise ValueError(text)
73	    return total + section + (digit or 0)
74	
75	
76	def parse_number(raw: str, units: dict[str, float]) -> tuple[float, list[str]]:
77	    text = raw.strip().replace(",", "").replace("，", "")
78	    readings: list[str] = []
79	    for unit, factor in sorted(units.items(), key=lambda item: -len(item[0])):
80	        if unit and text.endswith(unit):
81	            value, inner = parse_number(text[: -len(unit)], {})
82	            if factor != 1:
83	                readings.append(f"{unit} × {factor:g}")
84	            return value * factor, inner + readings
85	    if PLAIN_NUMBER.match(text):
86	        return float(text), readings
87	    if match := ARABIC_WITH_SECTION.match(text):
88	        unit = match.group(2)
89	        factor = CHINESE_SECTIONS.get(unit) or CHINESE_UNITS[unit]
90	        return float(match.group(1)) * factor, [f"{unit} = {factor:,}"]
91	    if text and all(
92	        ch in CHINESE_DIGITS or ch in CHINESE_UNITS or ch in CHINESE_SECTIONS for ch in text
93	    ):
94	        return float(chinese_number(text)), ["中文數字"]
95	    raise ValueError(raw)
96

98	def parse_hours(raw: str) -> tuple[float, list[str]]:
99	    text = raw.strip()
100	    if PLAIN_NUMBER.match(text):
101	        return float(text), []
102	    match = HOURS_AND_MINUTES.match(text)
103	    if not match or not (match.group(1) or match.group(2)):
104	        raise ValueError(raw)
105	    hours = float(match.group(1) or 0)
106	    minutes = float(match.group(2) or 0)
107	    readings = ["60 分鐘 = 1 小時"] if match.group(2) else []
108	    return hours + minutes / 60, readings
109	
110	
111	def real_date(year: int, month: int, day: int, raw: str) -> date:
112	    try:
113	        return date(year, month, day)
114	    except ValueError:
115	        raise UnusableValueError(f"「{raw}」不是存在的日期") from None
116	
117	
118	def parse_date(raw: str, today: date) -> tuple[date, list[str]]:
119	    text = raw.strip()
120	    if text in RELATIVE_DAYS:
121	        return today + timedelta(days=RELATIVE_DAYS[text]), [f"以今天 {today} 推算"]
122	    if match := DAYS_FROM_NOW.match(text):
123	        days = int(match.group(1)) * (1 if match.group(2) in "後后" else -1)
124	        return today + timedelta(days=days), [f"以今天 {today} 推算"]
125	    if match := FULL_DATE.match(text):
126	        year, month, day = (int(g) for g in match.groups())
127	        return real_date(year, month, day, raw), []
128	    if match := MONTH_DAY.match(text):
129	        month, day = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2))
130	        return real_date(today.year, month, day, raw), [f"未寫年份，以 {today.year} 年計"]
131	    if match := MONTH_EDGE.match(text):
132	        year = int(match.group(1)) if match.group(1) else today.year
133	        month = int(match.group(2))
134	        if not 1 <= month <= MONTHS:
135	            raise UnusableValueError(f"「{raw}」不是存在的月份")
136	        last = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
137	        day = last if match.group(3) == "底" else 1
138	        readings = [f"「{match.group(3)}」讀成 {month} 月 {day} 日"]
139	        if not match.group(1):
140	            readings.append(f"未寫年份，以 {year} 年計")
141	        return date(year, month, day), readings
142	    raise ValueError(raw)
143	
144	
145	def within_bounds(value: float, field: dict, raw: str) -> None:
146	    low, high = field.get("min"), field.get("max")
147	    if low is not None and value < low:
148	        raise UnusableValueError(f"「{raw}」小於可能的最小值 {low:g}")
149	    if high is not None and value > high:
150	        raise UnusableValueError(f"「{raw}」大於可能的最大值 {high:g}")
151	
152	
153	def scaled(value: float, out_of: float, field: dict, raw: str) -> tuple[float, list[str]]:
154	    scale = field.get("out_of")
155	    if out_of <= 0 or value > out_of:
156	        raise UnusableValueError(f"「{raw}」的分子大於分母")
157	    if scale is None or scale == out_of:
158	        return value, []
159	    return value / out_of * scale, [f"{value:g}/{out_of:g} 換算成滿分 {scale:g}"]
160	
161	
162	def normalize(field: dict, raw: object, today: date) -> tuple[object, list[str]]:
163	    kind = field["type"]
164	    if kind == "text":
165	        return str(raw), []
166	    text = str(raw)
167	    if kind == "date":
168	        value, readings = parse_date(text, today)
169	        if field.get("not_after_today") and value > today:
170	            raise UnusableValueError(f"「{text}」晚於今天 {today}")
171	        if field.get("not_before_today") and value < today:
172	            raise UnusableValueError(f"「{text}」早於今天 {today}")
173	        return value.isoformat(), readings
174	    if kind == "hours":
175	        number, readings = parse_hours(text)
176	    elif match := FRACTION.match(text.replace(",", "")):
177	        number, readings = scaled(float(match.group(1)), float(match.group(2)), field, text)
178	    else:
179	        number, readings = parse_number(text, field.get("units") or {})
180	    within_bounds(number, field, text)
181	    if field.get("integer") and number != int(number):
182	        raise
